question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Adversity
solution:
The correct answer is '**Misfortune**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Adversity'** refers to a difficult or unfavourable situation or circumstances. It represents times of hardship or catastrophe. (विपत्ति or कठिनाई)

 
 
• **Example**: "During the recession, many businesses faced **adversity **due to loss of income."
 
 
 
• '**Misfortune**' implies unfortunate conditions or events that are unfavourable or detrimental. (दुर्भाग्य)
 
 
• **Example**: "The family met with **misfortune **when their house was destroyed in the fire."
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for '**adversity**' is '**misfortune**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allegiance**: This term refers to loyalty or commitment to a superior, group, or cause. (निष्ठा or समर्पण)
 
• **Anxiety**: This term denotes a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease, often about an imminent event or something with an uncertain outcome. (चिंता or भय)
 
• **Progress**: The term signifies forward or onward movement toward a destination. (प्रगति or उन्नति)
